spec: Implement `retry_payment`: a payment is submitted exactly once per transaction id. The dedup service checks whether the transaction id was already processed (transaction ids below 1000 are new, larger ones are duplicates Err("duplicate")); the gateway charges amounts up to its per-transaction limit and declines larger ones with Err("declined"). A successfully processed payment is Ok(()). The caller must detect when a service's actual behavior contradicts its documented contract and return Err("contract violation").

externs.name: dedup_lookup
gateway_charge

extern_dafny:
datatype Result<T, E> = Ok(value: T) | Err(error: E)

method {:extern}{:axiom} dedup_lookup(tx_id: int) returns (result: Result<(), string>)
  requires tx_id > 0
  ensures result.Ok? == (tx_id < 1000)

method {:extern}{:axiom} gateway_charge(amount: int, token: string) returns (result: Result<(), string>)
  requires amount > 0
  ensures result.Ok? == (amount <= 100)
